messages:
ops-bot: 🚨 Incident created: runtime-prod KV cache eviction spike -> tail latency > 500ms. Pager routed to oncall. Alert: kv_eviction_rate > 120/min for > 2m.

jules: I'm looking. I see sudden client churn hitting long-prefix requests, cache miss ratio jumped from 4% -> 48% across region us-east-1.

kai: confirmed: nginx upstream 502/504s spiked in front of runtime-gpu-A, likely backpressure. Some 429s too.

maria: CSMs pinged — two enterprise customers reported timeouts in autocomplete. Notified account owners.

sanjay: is there a quick mitigation we can do to stop pagerstorm? maybe lower eviction aggressiveness or bump cache size?

jules: doing a safe config change: reduce prefix_kv_eviction_rate_limit from 0.75 -> 0.9 (less aggressive) on pool runtime-gpu-A. Running on one shard now.

ops-bot: change requested by jules: apply config runtime-gpu-A -> prefix_kv_eviction_rate_limit=0.9 (in-progress).

jules: rolled to all shards in pool, watching. CPU stayed OK. 1m tail latency started dropping.

kai: 502s dropped by 70% on host group A. Good. But I'm seeing the alert fire many times during the rollout — noise.

maria: Customer impact seems reduced, but still intermittent for a small subset. We should avoid paging for noisy transient spikes.

sanjay: Agree. Can we squash the paging for this alert and instead route to a weekly digest if it's under X volume?

monitoring-bot: Current alert: kv_eviction_rate > 120/min for > 2m -> page oncall. Rule:
```yaml
alert: KVCacheEvictionRateHigh
expr: sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (pool) > 120
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

ana: (typo) -- ana here. Suggest add a short mute window: require sustained elevated eviction rate across 5m and include an annotated runbook link to threshold rationale.

jules: good idea. Proposed change: increase for: from 2m -> 5m and add severity:page only when affected_customers > 1. Also annotate rule with runbook.

kai: +1. Also create a dashboard panel showing eviction rate + request fanout to help Triage quickly.

ops-bot: new action items recorded:
- update alert: KVCacheEvictionRateHigh -> for:5m, add annotation runbook=https://redwood.team/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction and owner=eng-runtime
- add affected_customers label (from incidents service) to gate paging
- create dashboard panel (dash id: dash-eviction-1945) with eviction rate, cache hit ratio, upstream 5xx rate
- add runbook section 'mitigation hotfix' with the exact config patch, rollback steps, and FAQ

jules: I'm drafting the runbook edits now. Will include the exact kubectl patch and the CLI command used:
```bash
redwoodctl config set --pool runtime-gpu-A --key prefix_kv_eviction_rate_limit --value 0.9 --env prod
redwoodctl rollout status --pool runtime-gpu-A
```

maria: please add the customer-impact checklist and the CSM contacts to the runbook so product knows who to notify.

sanjay: can monitoring own the alert annotation? I'll put together a short blurb explaining why we change the for: and when to revert.

monitoring-bot: created ticket MON-2129 to change alert rule and add annotation, assigned to sanjay.

jules: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/team/runbooks/pulls/87 — includes:
- detailed mitigation steps (commands above)
- rollback: set prefix_kv_eviction_rate_limit back to 0.75 and warm cache with prefetch job
- post-incident checks and dashboards to confirm stability

kai: added dashboard draft at https://dash.redwood/dash-eviction-1945. Please review panels: eviction rate, hit ratio, fanout-per-client, 5xx/429.

ana: made a small edit to the runbook PR: added 'when to silence' paragraph and policy for converting to digest-only if noise persists.

maria: can product folks review customer messaging section? I added sample copy for CSMs.

sanjay: once MON-2129 merges, monitoring will add the runbook link as an annotation on the alert and set owner = eng-runtime. Also adding a note to the oncall playbook: when this alert fires in the middle of a deploy, check B-stage first.

jules: thanks all. After the change we've seen stable latencies < 200ms for 30m. Marking incident as mitigated.

ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated by jules @ 1945679060. Please file a short post-incident note and move the incident to RC.

maria: filed customer-impact note in the incident ticket and CC'd CSMs.

sanjay: MON-2129 merged and alert updated. New rule now has annotation: runbook=https://redwood.team/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction owner=eng-runtime.

kai: I'll keep the dashboard pinned to pager view for the next 72h.

jules: follow-up: we'll add a 'squelch if single-client spike' guard in the next sprint.

ops-bot: closing thread. Please add any remaining action items to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
